title: Markov cohort model for long-term AI evaluation
primary_chapter_title: Decision Modelling, Simulation, and the Value of Information
purpose: Simulates repeated transitions among health states for AI and usual care, accumulating discounted costs and QALYs over time.
input: `States` sheet with state, cost per cycle, utility; `Usual_Transitions` and `AI_Transitions` square transition matrices; `Parameters` sheet with cycles, discount rates, initial state, cohort size, and willingness-to-pay.
outputs: State traces, discounted cost and QALY totals, incremental cost/effect, ICER/NMB, occupancy chart, and cohort projections.
limitations: This is an educational example. It is not a clinical device, validated decision instrument, or substitute for local statistical, economic, legal, privacy, cybersecurity, ethics, quality, or health-technology-assessment review.
